title: Two C5 inputs. One growing carbon chain.
두 C5 기질에서 시작하는 탄소 사슬.
intro: DMAPP + IPP → GPP. Each further IPP adds C5: C20 GGPP → C25 GFPP → a C30 linear diphosphate with suitable enzymes. C30 squalene instead comes from 2 × C15 FPP. KPP and other CLPP examples already carry clerodane backbones; dotted lines indicate scaffold membership.
IPP는 한 번에 C5를 더합니다. GGPP(C20) → GFPP(C25) → 선형 C30 이인산과, 2 FPP에서 만들어지는 C30 squalene은 구분해야 합니다. KPP와 다른 CLPP는 이미 clerodane 골격을 가진 중간체입니다.

edges.label: IDI · IPP ⇌ DMAPP
edges.detail: Reversible isomerization interconverts IPP and DMAPP. The arrow has heads at both ends; this does not replace the separate condensation reaction.

edges.label: IPP input · GPPS
edges.detail: IPP is consumed together with DMAPP: DMAPP + IPP → GPP + diphosphate. The two incoming lines depict the two co-substrates of one condensation, not two independent GPP-producing reactions.

edges.label: DMAPP input · GPPS
edges.detail: DMAPP and IPP are both required in this common C10-forming condensation. Neither line represents substrate-alone conversion.

edges.label: + IPP · FPPS
edges.detail: GPP + IPP → FPP + diphosphate in the common sequential elongation scheme.

edges.label: + IPP · GGPPS
edges.detail: FPP + IPP → GGPP + diphosphate in a common elongation scheme.

edges.label: TPS I · C10
edges.detail: Representative monoterpene cyclization.

edges.label: TPS I · C15
edges.detail: Representative sesquiterpene cyclization.

edges.label: 2 FPP · SQS · C30
edges.detail: Two FPP molecules supply squalene through presqualene diphosphate, with NADPH.

edges.label: KPS · TPS II · C20
edges.detail: Class II cyclization creates a C20 clerodane-related diphosphate. GGPP also supplies CPP, ent-CPP, syn-CPP and HPP branches in the diterpene view.

edges.label: C20 scaffold relationship
edges.detail: KPP is one specific clerodane-related C20 diphosphate. The generic clerodane family is not exclusively derived from this single absolute stereoisomer; other CLPP configurations also carry this scaffold. This dotted line denotes structural membership only.

edges.label: 2 GGPP · PSY · C40
edges.detail: Two C20 GGPP molecules condense into C40 phytoene. This branch increases the parent carbon skeleton to C40.

edges.label: + IPP · C20 + C5 = C25
edges.detail: One C5 addition yields C25 geranylfarnesyl diphosphate, with an enzyme of suitable chain-length specificity. It does not yield C30.

edges.label: + IPP · C25 + C5 = C30
edges.detail: Further C5 elongation gives a C30 linear hexaprenyl diphosphate in suitable medium-chain prenyltransferase systems. This is not the two-FPP coupling used to make squalene.

edges.label: other characterized TPS II products
edges.detail: Different class II TPSs or tested variants produce distinct CLPP stereoisomers; one example is cis-trans CLPP from PvCPS1. The panel is illustrative, not an exhaustive substrate–enzyme catalogue.

edges.label: already a clerodane-related C20 core
edges.detail: These diphosphates already contain clerodane-related carbon skeletons. This line denotes scaffold membership, not conversion into a free saturated clerodane parent compound.

edges.label: Relative molecular model
edges.detail: C20 diphosphate connectivity with independently defined relative pairs. Absolute configuration, relationships between the two pairs and side-chain E/Z are not assigned.

edges.label: Clerodane scaffold class
edges.detail: Scaffold membership only; this is not an additional biochemical conversion.

edges.label: Relative molecular model
edges.detail: C20 diphosphate connectivity with independently defined relative pairs. Absolute configuration, relationships between the two pairs and side-chain E/Z are not assigned.

edges.label: Clerodane scaffold class
edges.detail: Scaffold membership only; this is not an additional biochemical conversion.

edges.label: PvCPS1 / variants - reference
edges.detail: The study used the cis-prenyl substrate NNPP to obtain an alternative CLPP diastereomer. This does not assign a substrate or product to an uncharacterised enzyme.

edges.label: IPP input · NDPS1
edges.detail: DMAPP and IPP are consumed together to form NPP. These two lines are co-substrate inputs to the same condensation, not independent substrate-alone conversions.

edges.label: DMAPP input · NDPS1
edges.detail: DMAPP and IPP are consumed together to form NPP. These two lines are co-substrate inputs to the same condensation, not independent substrate-alone conversions.

edges.label: (+)-BPS · TPS I · C10
edges.detail: Class I bornyl diphosphate synthase cyclises GPP and recaptures diphosphate. Diphosphate retention does not establish TPS II chemistry.

edges.label: C10 framework membership
edges.detail: Bornyl diphosphate already carries a bornane-related C10 framework. This dotted line is classification, not a conversion to a saturated free parent.
